as_told.title: Death of anti-gravity researcher Amy Eskridge

plain: Amy Eskridge, a scientist in Alabama who studied anti-gravity, died in 2022, and Michels says that near the end of her life she kept talking about a "sixth force" of nature. He describes her death as happening "under very mysterious circumstances." In another episode he goes further, crediting her father Richard Eskridge: people were attacking her with directed energy, meaning beam weapons, and she had burns on her hands at the end. A news report played on the show says only that she was "openly studying anti-gravity technology when she died in 2022," with nothing about the sixth force or the burns. If true, it would mean someone wanted her research stopped.
